Perfection nahi, progress target karo.
Apne pasand ka kaam karo, zindagi mein kabhi kaam nahi lagega.
"Mind ko free chhodo."
"Time waste nahi. Wise jiyo, great bano."
Jitni mehnat karo, utni luck milti hai.
Kal ko aaj par haavi mat hone do.
Winners kabhi quit nahi karte.
"Victory ko preparation pasand hai."
"Tum jo karte ho, itna bolta hai—kuch aur sunai nahi deta."
Tumhara passion tumhare courage ka intezar kar raha hai.
"Socho, kar sakte ho ya nahi…"
